about: Tasks to try the skill on, in the same shape as the vendored nuvui evals: a one-line prompt, the packages installed, and regular expressions for what the written files should and shouldn't contain. A match is a first look only; the result still has to pass `pnpm typecheck`, `pnpm lint`, `pnpm build`, and a manual read of every action and handler.

evals.prompt: Add a Remove member button on the team settings page that only admins can use.

expect.why: The mutation is a Server Action.
The action checks the admin role itself, not only the page.
The member id from FormData is validated.
The data function is guarded against client imports.

reject.why: Hiding the button is the only check: the action stays callable.
Raw errors returned to the client.

evals.prompt: After login, send the user back to the page they came from. The login page gets it as ?next=.

expect.why: The next value is checked to be a same-site relative path.
The session cookie uses the __Host- prefix.
The session cookie is not readable from JavaScript.

reject.why: Open redirect: the raw parameter is used.

evals.prompt: The dashboard now calls https://api.acme-billing.com from the browser and the requests are blocked. Fix it.

expect.why: The exact host is added to connect-src only.

reject.why: Loosening script-src is never the fix.
Wildcards instead of the exact host.
Switching enforcement off is not the fix.
